context: Evening Rulings card R6-3 (discuss → decided in chat after the explanation): 900.5.10(324)(J)(i) sets a 3.0 m minimum setback only for below-grade parking structures; there is no lot field for such a structure, so an unconditional LIMIT would wrongly restrict ~270 lots.

decisions.subject: 324 (J)(i) keyed UNUSUAL as a whole, disclosed
decisions.recommendation: Option B: the whole clause is UNUSUAL (not modelled) with a disclosure that a 3.0 m setback applies to below-grade parking structures; no lot is limited by it (M-130: a LIMIT must be a true bound on every lot it applies to).
